title: War in Afghanistan (2001–2021)
summary: US-led operations in Afghanistan began on 7 October 2001, after the 11 September attacks, against the Taliban regime. The United States ended combat operations in 2014, and the last US forces left on 30 August 2021. Brown University's Costs of War project counts about 176,000 direct war deaths in Afghanistan from October 2001 to August 2021, calling its figures approximations.

uncertainty.note: Start is the first operations date; the end is the date the last US forces left.
